The <b>Everbloom</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Equipment|equipment item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is required to be able to complete the <i>[[DESCEND: Last Dive]]</i> Main Objective and achieve the [[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 4: Sister of the Void|ending]] to [[Act 3]].

== Background ==
Everblooms were brought to [[Hallownest]] from "lands serene" by the [[Five Great Knights|Great Knight]] [[Grey Mourner|Ze'mer]], where they became known as [[Delicate Flower|Delicate Flowers]].<ref>[[White Lady]]: <i>"Not of me that flower, nor of this kingdom. Far it travelled to reach this place, brought by one beloved, fair knight of lands serene. There is rare power hidden in those frail petals. To hold it so close, one must surely be unaware of its nature... "</i></ref> The flowers are rare, sacred objects which have a pure aura.<ref>[[Grey Mourner]]: <i>"A sacred flower is the offering. It is a rare, delicate object."</i></ref><ref>[[Eternal Emilitia]]: <i>"Though even its pure aura is no match for the light of our dear King."</i></ref> They glow with soft, pale light that wards against the [[Void]].<ref>Everbloom inventory description <i>"Glows with soft, pale light that wards against the void."</i></ref> 

The [[Pale King|King]] and [[White Lady|Queen]] of Hallownest had an Everbloom in their possession, referring to it as "the first light" and the only means they had to resist the Void.<ref>[[White Lady]]: <i>"Witness, the first light. The only means we possess to resist that void with which our family is forever linked."</i></ref>

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is able to bring an Everbloom to [[Pharloom]] by entering the [[Red Memory]] and using the power of her [[Silk]] to manifest it physically.

== Function ==
Allows Hornet to dive into the Void to free [[Lace]] at the end of the DESCEND: Last Dive Main Objective. It also protects Hornet from being damaged while swimming in the sea of Void in [[the Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]], and prevents Silk drain when taking Void damage.

[[Void Tendrils (Silksong)|Void Tendrils]] don't thrash when Hornet is nearby if she has the Everbloom. They also avoid her when she's swimming in the Void, only thrashing a certain distance away from her. If [[Grand Mother Silk]] screams when Hornet is submerged in the Void, the Void Tendrils will still thrash about, but won't damage Hornet.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by the [[White Lady]] during the Red Memory.
